charts.question: Compounded total return after trading costs
charts.supported_finding: Fund inputs are weekly NAV total returns with ex-date distributions reinvested.
charts.interpretation_boundary: A backtest using fund NAVs is a modeled portfolio. Shorting and funding spreads beyond the stated transaction cost can change the comparison. The non-rate residual includes liquidity and issuer-specific risk.
